roles.purpose: Own the build and runtime toolchain: the root `pom.xml`, module poms, plugin and dependency versions, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and the `ledger-app` packaging and `ledger-app/Dockerfile`.
roles.modelReason: Version bumps and build configuration are well-specified, tool-heavy work where a coding-tuned model is efficient.

roles.purpose: Own `ledger-core`: postings, journals, balancing and rounding, including optional Java 21 language modernisation in code it changes.
roles.modelReason: Small domain module with strong tests; careful but not deep reasoning.

roles.purpose: Own `ledger-persistence`: the JDBC repository, Flyway migrations, the PostgreSQL driver and Testcontainers integration tests.
roles.modelReason: JDBC and migration work is mechanical but needs tests run against a real database.

roles.purpose: Review each feature PR for unchanged balances, rounding and HTTP API behavior, reproducible builds and the one-concern-per-PR upgrade rule.
roles.modelReason: A different model family from the implementers gives an independent review at moderate cost.
